data.one_liner: Collects, manipulates, and formats code coverage data in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides tools to collect coverage JSON from the Dart VM Service and format it into LCOV or pretty-printed formats. Supports ignoring specific lines or ranges from coverage and handling function or branch coverage.
use_when: You need to generate lcov.info files for test coverage reporting
You want to collect coverage data from the Dart VM Service
You need to filter out ignored lines using coverage comments
avoid_when: You are looking for a state management or UI library
You do not need test coverage metrics for your Dart project
strengths: Supports LCOV and pretty-printed format output
Supports function and branch coverage collection
Provides comment directives to ignore lines or files from coverage
weaknesses: Web coverage percentage metrics and line counts are not directly comparable to VM runs
data.setup_notes: Run dart pub global activate coverage and optionally add the executables to your PATH.
